newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pension Welfare Corp investment losses Y1.42 trln.
newsitem.headline: Pension Welfare Corp investment losses Y1.42 trln.

text.p: Pension Welfare Service Public Corp's investment losses totalled 1.42 trillion yen at the end of March, the public body said on Monday.
The corporation said in a statement that it lost 413.3 billion yen in fiscal 1996/97 alone due to a negative interest rate spread.
The corporation earned 763 billion yen from its investments in fiscal 1996/97, but had to pay interest of 1.176 trillion yen to the Finance Ministry's Trust Fund Bureau.
The corporation has posted net losses on its investment operations since fiscal 1991/92, and recorded cumulative losses since fiscal 1993/94.
Public pension schemes deposit their funds with the Trust Fund Bureau, which the corporation then borrows from.
The corporation invests some of the money itself, and has private financial institutions such as trust banks and life insurers manage the rest.
The problem in recent years has been that the income the corporation has earned from its investments has been less than what it cost to borrow the money.
The corporation had assets of 22.51 trillion yen as of the end of March.
